status: PLANNING EXPERIMENTS — NOT APPROVED BALANCE CONSTANTS

method.cohortPolicy: Highest-weight offered gift; at each manual pick maximize offered ceiling times attribute weight; no rerolls. Identical original prospects, initial RNG and per-game seed stream paired across schools, policies and variants.
method.strategies: Stay focuses highest-weight non-gift trait; rotate cycles all eight non-gift traits by descending OVR weight; adaptive picks largest weighted unrealized gap per block. Decisions cover four-game blocks. Interventions ON means automatic one-game substitution, not clicking Use coach’s focus.
method.potential: Weighted mean of stored trait ceilings, not current ability. Low/excellent strata are within-mode bottom/top quintile cutoffs, not athlete labels. Ties can enlarge strata.
method.experimentalInitial: All A/B/C add eight to each non-gift starting attribute, clipped at its own ceiling (equivalent paired 58–73 integer draws); Natural Gift remains94. No source/ceiling changes. No 100/95/90 modifier included.
method.limitations: Controlled deterministic model experiments, not telemetry or a real-football calibration. Same200 builds per mode reused across conditions; condition totals are not independent samples. No continuity coefficients, recruiting or new school ceiling system. Current game simulator including known scoring defects is retained; production-stat outputs do not demonstrate realism. Upper-tail estimates in small strata are uncertain.

additionalCohorts.syntheticProfiles: Fictional low72 / typical87 / exceptional99 non-gift ceilings; fixed route-running Natural Gift starts94 with ceiling99; all other initial abilities50..65. Neutral185cm/90kg physical profile. These are not changed grades for real receivers.
additionalCohorts.heldOutUse: Independent seeds for baseline and candidate C after the initial three-way comparison; same production creation policy. Repeated conditions reuse each build.
